policy: Only entries marked implemented are release claims. partial and blocked entries require a task-specific parity gate.

capabilities.name: six_point_one_sided_focal
capabilities.reason: The pinned PoseLib six-point adapter is integrated into the asymmetric known-second-camera RANSAC path and the deterministic exact-sample gate passes. It remains partial because the public adapter still accepts normalized 2D rays and lacks COLMAP's calibrated-ray unprojection Jacobian refinement for distorted and spherical models.
prerequisites: calibrated-ray type carrying ray plus d(ray)/d(pixel)
capabilities.resolution: Port CamRayWithJac-compatible data through the camera API, use the tangent Sampson denominator in RANSAC/LO, then add distorted and spherical numeric parity cases before promotion.

capabilities.name: global_mapper_multi_component
capabilities.reason: The compatible equivalent is now implemented: all database images are partitioned, verified-match components are mapped independently, and component reconstructions are merged.

capabilities.name: caspar_gpu_bundle_adjustment
capabilities.reason: Current tree has PBA and optional Ceres CUDA, but no Caspar kernels or reproducible parity benchmark.
prerequisites: BA speed and reprojection parity gate
capabilities.resolution: Import generated Caspar f32/f64 through 3rdparty, add the BA backend selector/fallback, then pass CUDA-vs-Ceres reprojection and controlled runtime gates.

capabilities.name: loma_lightglue
capabilities.reason: LightGlue inference is ggml-backed; COLMAP LoMa weights and a ggml LoMa graph are not available. ONNX Runtime is not added and must remain absent.
capabilities.resolution: Convert the pinned LoMa weights to GGUF, implement the graph in the existing ggml task layer, and gate match precision/recall against the COLMAP reference; do not add ONNX Runtime.

capabilities.name: hip_patchmatch
capabilities.reason: PatchMatch is CUDA-only in this tree; HIP kernels require a separate ROCm build and device-parity gate.
capabilities.resolution: Provide a ROCm runner with hipcc, add the CUDA-to-HIP shim and HIP translation unit in 3rdparty/mvs, then run depth-map parity and performance tests.

capabilities.name: camera_models_and_rigs
capabilities.reason: Existing camera and rig support is retained; modern spherical model and all upstream rig fixes need model-by-model API and reconstruction parity tests.
capabilities.resolution: Port the equirectangular model and spherical-aware geometry/BA paths, preserve camera text/binary serialization, and pass per-model plus rig reconstruction parity tests.

capabilities.name: freeimage_to_openimageio
capabilities.validation: bitmap_test; local OIIO compile; stale-FreeImage source audit
capabilities.reason: The Reconstruction Bitmap ABI no longer exposes FreeImage and is backed by OpenImageIO. Conda-forge provides the pinned 3.1.17.0 package for linux-64, osx-64, osx-arm64, and win-64; its Linux glibc >=2.17 constraint covers Ubuntu 20.04 through 24.04. The four remote platform parity jobs still need to run before a release claim.
prerequisites: Ubuntu 20.04/22.04/24.04 image, EXIF, resize, undistortion, and texture parity jobs
macOS and Windows Conda parity jobs
capabilities.resolution: Run the pinned OIIO parity matrix in CI. Promote only when every platform produces matching bitmap, EXIF, resize, undistortion, and texture results.
